title: Actions against Employers Accused of Workplace Discrimination Based on Age and Race
what_it_is: Actions against Employers Accused of Workplace Discrimination Based on Age and Race

sections.label: Enforcement against discriminatory employers
sections.summary: Employers may be advised to rectify HR lapses, and MOM can curtail work pass privileges in serious discrimination cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Other than requiring employers to attend corrective workshops conducted by TAFEP, employers can be advised to rectify lapses in their HR processes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM will not hesitate to take enforcement actions against discriminatory employers such as curtailing their work pass privileges in more serious cases.

sections.label: FCF watch list
sections.summary: Firms with some degree of discriminatory practices may be placed on a Fair Consideration Framework watch list.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Currently, firms that may have some degree of discriminatory practices may be put on a Fair Consideration Framework, or FCF, watch list.

sections.label: Employers respond to TAFEP engagement
sections.summary: Most employers on the FCF watch list have responded to TAFEP's engagement and expanded local employment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In most instances, employers who are on this FCF watch list have been responsive to TAFEP's engagement efforts and expanded the employment of local employees.

sections.label: Naming firms negative consequence
sections.summary: Naming firms could have a negative consequence by frustrating their efforts to recruit and hire people.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Naming firms, sometimes, could also end up having a negative consequence because it would then frustrate their efforts to recruit and hire people.

sections.label: Enforcement and PME engagement
sections.summary: Enforcement actions will be taken against firms that refuse or persist in discriminatory actions, while the Labour Movement and SNEF engaged over 10,000 PMEs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As I said, for firms that, despite our efforts to engage them, refuse or have persisted in their discriminatory actions, we will take enforcement actions against them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Essentially, the Labour Movement, together with Singapore National Employers Federation (SNEF), has been engaging more than 10,000 professionals, managers and executives (PMEs) in the past year.

sections.label: Engaging HR practitioners and agencies
sections.summary: MOM wants to focus engagement on HR practitioners and employment agencies because they link employers and hiring practices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Indeed, HR practitioners and employment agencies are areas of engagement that MOM would want to focus on because they form the link between the employers and the hiring practices of the companies.
